data.narrative:
Valstad is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Dustin Walper that has raised $2.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI), supplemented by reference to a broader Defense & Security landscape spanning 10 private companies and 2 public equities.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression methodology uses total capital raised ($2.6M) as a proxy for current value and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next funding stage, yielding $6M. Peer-Median triangulation captures the median valuation across the three direct comparables at $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $1.0B (UFORCE, Seed). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in maturity and traction within the Defense & Security frontier segment.

Triangulating these methods produces a range of $6M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $203M. The two-order-of-magnitude spread reflects material uncertainty: Stage-Progression anchors to capital deployed and stage conventions, while Peer-Median is sensitive to comp selection and the extreme valuations observed in the sector. Key uncertainties include Valstad's differentiation within the peer set, revenue or product-market signal quality, and founder track record relative to UFORCE and other high-valued seed peers. Additional data on product maturity and customer validation would narrow this range substantially.
